hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$f" ]; then case "$f" in *.cpp|*.hpp|*.cc|*.h|*.cxx|*.hxx) CF=$(command -v clang-format 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$CF" ]; then CF=$(ls $HOME/.vscode/extensions/ms-vscode.cpptools-*/LLVM/bin/clang-format 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; if [ -n "$CF" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then "$CF" -i "$f"; fi ;; esac; fi

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; CF=$(command -v clang-format 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$CF" ]; then CF=$(ls $HOME/.vscode/extensions/ms-vscode.cpptools-*/LLVM/bin/clang-format 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; [ -n "$CF" ] || exit 0; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d -- '*.cpp' '*.hpp' '*.cc' '*.h' '*.cxx' '*.hxx' | while IFS= read -r f; do if [ -f "$f" ] && [ -n "$(find "$f" -newermt '-120 seconds' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then "$CF" -i "$f"; fi; done
